index.html.title: ByteSize | Byte size tools
index.html.keywords: ByteSize This library makes byte quantities easier to work with by giving them a clear, unambiguous representation in code. Supports both decimal (SI) and binary (IEC) units (See this). Decimal: 1 kilobyte (KB) equals 1,000 bytes. Supported units include KB, MB, GB, TB, and PB. Binary: 1 kibibyte (KiB) equals 1,024 bytes. Supported units include KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB, and PiB. It handles conversions and provides methods for creating and retrieving values for any of those units. Check the API Docs Alternatives omar/ByteSize
